options.name: Clouded Vision
options.benefit: Vision is limited to 30 feet, but functions as darkvision. The range and supernatural senses improve at 5th, 10th, and 15th level.

options.name: Deaf
options.benefit: You are deaf, but cast spells as though modified by Silent Spell without increasing their level or casting time. Other senses improve at 5th, 10th, and 15th level.

options.name: Haunted
options.benefit: Spirits interfere with stored and dropped items, but grant bonus spells known that expand at 5th, 10th, and 15th level.

options.name: Lame
options.benefit: Your land speed is reduced, but encumbrance never reduces it. You gain protections against fatigue, armor speed reduction, and exhaustion as your curse advances.

options.name: Tongues
options.benefit: In combat you can speak and understand only a chosen supernatural language. You gain more languages and eventually universal understanding as your curse advances.

options.name: Wasting
options.benefit: Your decaying body penalizes most Charisma-based skills, but grants increasing resistance and immunity to disease, sickness, and nausea.
